body: Shiki in filemark (packages/mdx-viewer/src/shiki.ts) uses the JS regex engine, NOT WASM Oniguruma, deliberately to keep bundle <100KB. Singleton highlighterPromise; themes github-light/github-dark + per-language grammars loaded via dynamic import() on first use (LANGS map); LRU cache max 500 keyed lang:dark|light:fnv1a(code) with synchronous getCachedHighlight() to avoid unstyled flash; unsupported language silently falls back to lang=text (no error).
